name: mycrew-oversight
description: Layer 5/5 — the watch, above the chief. Start a session as overseer with `claude -n "OVERSIGHT <project>" --agent overseer` and it sees every other session in the project: at each trigger it asks whether the work still serves what you asked for, takes your own corrections as standing rules, stops what wandered and puts it through /why-do-it, and comes to you only with what the gate could not settle. Every trigger leaves a line on disk, so the whole watch reads back afterwards. It judges and stops; it never does the work and never says how.
